title: The Broken Vow
logline: A debt collector refuses to shake down an orphanage they grew up in, and their syndicate boss sends killers after them both.

roles.description: Grim, heavily scarred, drawing a line in the sand.
Sadistic, views mercy as a personal insult.
A rundown habitat housing displaced children.

public_situation: A well-known debt collector has gone rogue, and a massive bounty has been placed on their head.
private_truth: The collector grew up in the orphanage they were sent to extort, and killed their partner to protect it.

beats.public_change: The syndicate publicly brands the collector a traitor.

missions.reason: Needs emergency medical supplies picked up and delivered to the orphanage before the syndicate cuts them off.
missions.private_fact: The collector was wounded by their former syndicate partner and is desperately running out of supplies.

beats.public_change: Syndicate ships blockade the orphanage station.

missions.reason: Needs the pilot to destroy the hit squad before they breach the station hull.
missions.private_fact: The hit squad has orders to leave no survivors to send a message.

beats.public_change: The boss offers a fortune for the collector's location.

missions.reason: The collector needs the syndicate's heavy assault ship broken before it punches through the orphanage's emergency airlocks.
missions.private_fact: The gunship commander is authorized by {role:cruel_boss} to offer a syndicate fortune if the pilot turns away and lets them breach the station.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot destroys the second wave and defends the orphanage.
resolutions.summary: The syndicate backs off, realizing the cost is too high. The collector survives to protect their home.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot stood between syndicate gunships and a habitat housing displaced children.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot takes the assault ship commander's offer and lets the syndicate breach the station.
resolutions.summary: The collector is killed, and the orphanage is sold for scrap. The boss's authority is absolute.

consequences.public_summary: Word spread of a pilot taking syndicate coin while a shelter burned.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot fails the defense missions or abandons the contract.
resolutions.summary: Syndicate enforcers overrun the habitat airlocks. {role:rogue_collector} is taken in chains, and the displaced youths are scattered across local transit hubs.

loose_threads.detail: The orphanage station's original deed is registered to the cruel boss's holding company.
The syndicate assault ship carried corporate identification seals from a shipyard three systems away.

radio_hooks: Syndicate bounties disrupt local traffic in {system}.
Charity habitat in {system} reports armed vessels outside the perimeter.

voice_direction.rogue_collector: Speaks in short, strained sentences and avoids mentioning the past. Never calls the children victims.
voice_direction.cruel_boss: Speaks with formal politeness and bureaucratic calm. Never raises their voice or uses overt threats.
